historicalStatements: V34 IS A NEW PROSPECTIVE PHASE
oracleIsolation: Ordinary evidence exists on callback entry. A passive expected snapshot is permitted, but cannot flow to any acoustic stage, evidence, runtime arguments or pre-finalization control. All expected uses and comparisons must follow successful FINALIZED result. Runtime verdict is compared, never replaced.
retirement: Owner-issued capturedThroughSourceSample only; never owned/processed frontier; anchor strictly greater than committed physical boundary. Runtime acceptInputAfter/rearm then input.arm synchronously with no asynchronous gap. Failure after commit terminates, no rollback/reuse/replacement.
captureMapping: AudioContext is single clock; fixed origin and source sample mapping; no performance clock, fit or source timestamp rewrite
resourceGates: One root, clone, context, product Worker/session, source runtime, chronology, assembler and long-lived region per cell; ORT subordinate workers separately classified. Zero unclassified workers, unattributed lifecycles, hidden execution, observation reuse or reconnect; strict witnessed terminal cancellation allowed.
normalTeardown: Input disposal ends clone/capture and disposes Worker/source once, leaves root live and borrowed context running. Application cleanup then ends root/context separately.
contextLoss: Unchanged immutable executable uses actual AudioContext.suspend. Production watcher must observe real state change, terminal cleanup once, no post-failure evidence acceptance or failed-owner reuse.
recognition: Diagnostic only; no required MATCH, no source/target changes. Fresh same-target attempts are not cross-target isolation; absent natural MATCH/advancement report CROSS_TARGET_SAME_PITCH_ISOLATION_NOT_EVALUATED.
network: Exact frozen local routes only; no external network, backend or fallback asset source
stopRules: Any executed mandatory prelaunch step failure permanently stops V34
One fresh campaign, zero cell retries, no historical cell result reuse
First mandatory browser/audit failure stops remaining cells
Unattributed request lifecycle or hidden execution blocks success; fully witnessed terminal cancellation does not
CI: Deferred by product owner, not a browser gate. Local checks are not CI. Query final remote statuses/workflows; absent means NOT CI PASS
closeout: Frozen single-process state machine; synchronous push completion barrier; result proof refers to RESULT_COMMIT, receipt-only final commit, terminal stdout without tracked writes or further commits after FINAL_REMOTE_VERIFIED

identityDomains.protectedRemoteAuthority: Git blob equality START vs FREEZE, never Git vs worktree byte equality
identityDomains.localExecutionAuthority: Exact historical worktree hashes remain local provenance, independently verified before launch
identityDomains.newResearchFreeze: LF sources/reports staged, frozen identity from git show :path (index content); commit content must equal that index identity
identityDomains.external: Exact RAW_BYTES_SHA256 bound in remote manifest; recheck locally before launch
identityDomains.virtual: Exact semantic identifier/provenance, never filesystem read
identityDomains.EOLPolicy: No Git config/.gitattributes/checkout/production text mutation; no EOL normalization to compare domains

inferenceLifecycle.completedAfterClose: ACKNOWLEDGED_COMPLETED_AFTER_TERMINAL_CLOSE_NOT_PUBLISHED is a completed subcategory, not cancellation
inferenceLifecycle.conservation: A = C + K; K <= 1; rejected promises = K
inferenceLifecycle.internalInterval: [C,C+K] is a session.run invocation interval, not a GPU kernel count
inferenceLifecycle.terminalRules: Normal terminal teardown only after frozen observation interval; context terminal teardown only after actual suspend/watcher. One known in-flight started request, unique identity, source/worker disposal once, outstanding 1 -> 0, no crash/error/unexpected response, no post-terminal infer/publication/EVIDENCE, no reuse.
inferenceLifecycle.workerTap: Observational Worker Proxy forwards constructor/postMessage/terminate and native events unchanged; records IDs/window metadata and passive immutable-entry snapshots, never payload changes or synthetic responses.
inferenceLifecycle.rejectedPromises: Separate field. Only strict terminal cancellations may explain rejections.
inferenceLifecycle.completionAuthority: Real wrapped promise receipts AND matching Worker response, exact sequential actualSessionRunCount from 1

sourceDiscovery.authority: START git ls-tree inventory; validate known required authoritative paths before read; no speculative source path probes

protocolCorrection: Only closeout serialization and self-reference-safe final verification differ from the V33 interpretation. No V33 cell evidence is reused.
